Familiar: Beckoned by Beauty.name: Familiar: Beckoned by Beauty
Familiar: Beckoned by Beauty.description: A helper familiar "ability" to auto-apply the penalties from @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-superstitions.Item.9eE6mkw8YuF8ijSV]{Beckoned by Beauty}.

Beckoned by Beauty.name: Beckoned by Beauty
Beckoned by Beauty.description:
You are certain you've heard of an entity like your familiar in old folk songs and dances; rhymes, parables, and tunes meant to impart strange lessons about the joys and horrors of life. Could your familiar be crafted by your patron to resemble such a creature... or is it perhaps from a plane where these depictions and folk lore are historical accounts?

You do not gain the second freely spent additional familiar ability at level 1, but instead your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.92lgSEPFIDLvKOCF]{Accompanist} familiar ability. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7LB00jkh6JaJr3vS]{Fascinating Performance} skill feat, ignoring its prerequisites. You may use the granted skill of your patron to Perform, using your proficiency in that skill to determine observers you can affect and to qualify for skill feats that would require a certain rank in Performance.

While in an encounter, until you or your familiar have used Perform during the encounter, you and your familiar take a -1 status penalty against mental effects, or a -2 status penalty if the mental effect has the emotion trait.

At 1st level when you would choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet}, you instead choose between @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.uvoUTlKWB0XJ8r7H]{Melodious Provocateur} and phase familiar.

Advanced Superstition

You and your familiar are now a performing duo. You do not gain an additional familiar ability at level 12, but your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} familiar ability in the skill granted by your patron. Your familiar can use that skill to Perform, and it gains the effects of Fascinating Performance when it uses Perform as if it were an expert in Performance.

Foundry Note You can add the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-superstitions.Item.3IetqDBC4vTTyo0L]{Familiar: Beckoned By Beauty} familiar "ability" for it to automatically receive the status penalties when you do.

The Foretold Harbinger.name: The Foretold Harbinger
The Foretold Harbinger.description:
You have come to understand that your familiar is of the utmost importance to the plan of your patron, and without it, terrible things will come to pass. You might have noticed similarities between it and prophesied entities which lead to the ultimate salvation or end of the world, or perhaps you were given cryptic instructions by your patron involving your familiar. One way or another, you do not want to find out what will happen if you lose your familiar.

You do not gain the second freely spent additional familiar ability at level 1, but instead your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.deC1yIM2S5szGdzT]{Lifelink} master ability. You become trained in Medicine and at 3rd level, you become an expert in Medicine, at 7th you become a master, and at 15th level, you become legendary.

When you are in an encounter, if your familiar is reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and you cannot target creatures other than your familiar while frightened.

At 1st level when you would choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet}, you instead choose between @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.Z2H0gIC7p4P6iSnV]{Fabled Familiar} and phase familiar.

Advanced Superstition

You have become confident in your guarding of your familiar, and know that you will accomplish your goal. You do not gain an additional familiar ability at level 12, but instead you only become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} instead of frightened 2 when your familiar is reduced to 0 Hit Points or dies, and you can use the lifelink master ability as a free action instead of a reaction.

Foundry Note You can apply the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-superstitions.Item.QdCElETzlH5H6TCd]{Familiar: The Foretold Harbinger} familiar "ability" to the familiar to give it a "death note"—it will be marked with a skull icon, so you know it activates on familiar death.

Protect Us O Spirit.name: Protect Us O Spirit
Protect Us O Spirit.description:
Your familiar seems intent on protecting you above all else. It licks your wounds when you are hurt and warns you of dangerous choices. In your mind, you think of stories like guardian angels, visiting ancestors or nature spirits, and wonder who exactly it is that your patron has sent to guide you.

You do not gain the second freely spent additional familiar ability at level 1, but instead your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.Q42nrq9LwDdbeZM5]{Restorative Familiar} master ability. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} general feat.

When you are in an encounter, if you are critically hit or critically fail a save your familiar becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and it cannot use actions that target creatures other than you until it is no longer frightened.

At 1st level when you would choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet}, you instead choose between patron's puppet and @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.SBQLTWQnfKP5Rohm]{Protective Visitation}.

Advanced Superstition

Your familiar understands the life of adventuring is dangerous, and the best way to handle that is with calm thinking. You do not gain an additional familiar ability at level 12, but instead your familiar can use restorative familiar once per hour instead of once per day and your familiar only becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} if you are critically hit or if you critically fail a save.

Familiar: The Foretold Harbinger.name: Familiar: The Foretold Harbinger
Familiar: The Foretold Harbinger.description: The familar's master becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, and cannot target creatures other than the familiar while frightened.

Heed the Call.name: Heed the Call
Heed the Call.description:
Your familiar whispers secrets to you, tells you of your greatness, and guides you down a path you do not understand. You know in myths, the goddess of justice was guided by a black cat with a white sock, and that the founder of the world's oldest school of magic spoke with the birds and the beasts for guidance. Is your situation truly so different..?

You do not gain the second freely spent additional familiar ability at level 1, but instead your familiar gains the speech familiar ability. You become trained in Society and at 3rd level, you become an expert in Society, at 7th you become a master, and at 15th level, you become legendary.

You and your familiar gain the edicts and anathema of a code or deity appropriate for your patron. If you or your familiar ever violate these edicts or anathema, you cannot give your familiar Commands until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} or make amends, or your familiar does the same.

At 1st level when you would choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet}, you instead choose between @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.pliuO4sFCloEfdda]{Devoted Glory} and patron's puppet.

Advanced Superstition

You have become confident in your mission, and your familiar has bestowed its trust in you to complete it. You do not gain an additional familiar ability at level 12, but instead when you encounter creatures that violate your edicts or anathema, either by their nature or from acts they have committed, you can use Society instead of Intimidation to Demoralize or Coerce these creatures, so long as your familiar is in your space.

It Is Ever-Learning.name: It Is Ever-Learning
It Is Ever-Learning.description:
Your familiar seems preoccupied with ancient and forgotten knowledge. You may have caught a glimpse of it reading your notes at the witching hour, or perhaps it seems to know far more than a simple animal possibly could. You might have attempted to appease it through extended studies... or, perhaps, you have nailed closed the unburnable books it drags home in an attempt to stop it getting too strong.

You do not gain the second freely spent additional familiar ability at level 1, but instead your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} familiar ability in the skill granted by your patron. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IlOQuCQIhjJpig3S]{Quick Identification} skill feat. At 3rd level, you become an expert in the skill granted by your patron, at 7th you become a master, and at 15th level, you become legendary.

When you first enter an encounter, until you or your familiar have used Recall Knowledge during the encounter, your familiar gains 1 less action when it gains its actions for the turn.

At 1st level when you would choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet}, you instead choose between @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.7ikAnqUXnnnBjl5n]{Familiar Lesson} and phase familiar.

Advanced Superstition

You and your familiar have adapted to each other, melding your knowledge together. You do not gain an additional familiar ability at level 12, but instead your familiar gains the second opinion familiar ability. Your familiar gains a +2 status bonus to its checks to Recall Knowledge and grants you the same status bonus when it Aids you on Recall Knowledge.

Familiar: It Is Ever-Learning.name: Familiar: It Is Ever-Learning
Familiar: It Is Ever-Learning.description: At level 12, the familiar gains a +2 status bonus to its checks to Recall knowledge.

None Shall Own It.name: None Shall Own It
None Shall Own It.description:
Your familiar—if you can call it "yours"—is an exceptionally independent being. It acts as a fickle being content from watching from afar, or a hissing animal that might claw you for coming too close. Maybe you've tried to leave it offerings to get it to aid you, like in stories of fey or spirits—or maybe, you just wish to survive it, and must perform minor rituals to keep it from creeping too close in the night.

You do not gain the second freely spent additional familiar ability at level 1, but instead your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.2fiQzoEKu6YUnrU9]{Independent} familiar ability. You become trained in Diplomacy and at 3rd level, you become an expert in Diplomacy, at 7th you become a master, and at 15th level, you become legendary.

When you are in an encounter, you must attempt to convince your familiar to take the actions you request when you give it a Command by making a @Check[type:diplomacy|traits:action:none-shall-own-it-command|dc:@self.level] check against a standard DC of your level. Once you succeed, you do not have to make these Diplomacy checks for 1 minute. Your familiar can still take its action from its independent ability if you fail your Diplomacy check to Command it.

At 1st level when you would choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet}, you instead choose between @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.76bM9W6HBzwBbKtq]{Autonomous Actor} and phase familiar.

Advanced Superstition

You have realized you can never “tame” your familiar, but you know now how to co-exist with it. You do not gain an additional familiar ability at level 12, but instead your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.asOhEdyF8CWFbR96]{Spellcasting} familiar ability. The DC of the @Check[type:diplomacy|traits:action:none-shall-own-it-command|dc:@self.level|adjustment:-2] check to Command your familiar becomes an easy DC of your level instead of a standard DC.
